idea-plugin.name: Git Heatmap
idea-plugin.description:
Git Heatmap analyzes Git history inside IntelliJ IDEA and visualizes repository activity as a file heatmap. It helps developers identify hotspot files, inspect commit and author activity, estimate engineering effort, compare branches, review code statistics, and track local Claude/Codex token usage without leaving the IDE.

Main features

  • Automatic Git history loading for the selected repository and branch.
  • File heatmap with per-file heat scores and interactive drill-down.
  • Sortable Files, Commits, and Authors views with added, deleted, net, effort, and message details.
  • Author and commit filters that scope Files, Commits, Heatmap, and summary together.
  • Optional date range filtering and PR Overlay branch comparison.
  • Multi-repository discovery with aggregate All repositories analysis.
  • Code Statistics with file format distribution, contribution calendar and trends, plus hourly commit/effort analysis.
  • Token Usage reads local Claude and Codex usage files without API keys or external uploads.
  • Global/repository scope, monthly/daily grouping, token/price views, model-aware estimates, fallback notices, and background loading.

Effort values are heuristic estimates for relative engineering effort visibility; they are not actual tracked time.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Git Heatmap 1.2.x updates

  • Added exact pricing for GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna.
  • Added Claude Sonnet 5 pricing alongside Fable 5 and Mythos 5 support.
  • Corrected Claude one-hour prompt-cache write calculations to use the proper pricing tier.
  • Added clear notices when an unknown model variant uses the latest known fallback price.
  • Added Token Usage filters for global/repository scope and monthly/daily grouping.
  • Added token and estimated price views for Claude and Codex usage.
  • Redesigned the Token Usage filter area with compact dropdown chips and improved light/dark theme contrast.
  • Moved Token Usage loading to the background so filter changes no longer block the UI.
  • Added automatic Git history loading when the tool window opens; the Load button remains available for manual reloads.
  • Updated README and Marketplace listing documentation to cover Code Statistics, Token Usage, multi-repository mode, and current workflows.
